spec.title: Availability
spec.description: Right now this is in active development stage, so it's entirely possible that I stopped the strategy to experiment. So don't get concerned if availability is 0 for some time! :)

spec.query:
SELECT last("pnl")
FROM "acct_lvl_daily_pnl"
WHERE ("level"::tag = '3' AND "label"::tag =~ /^DEFI--.*/)
  AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY time($__interval), "label"::tag
FILL(previous)

SELECT cumulative_sum(sum("expected_pnl_post_fill")) AS "Total Tx", cumulative_sum(sum("skew_adjusted_pnl_post_fill")) AS "Skew Adjusted Tx", cumulative_sum(sum("expected_pnl_pre_fill")) AS "Expected pnl" FROM "defi_cefi_arbitrage_post_fill_trade" WHERE ("stage" =~ /^$stage$/ AND "mode" =~ /^$mode$/ AND "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/ AND "network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND "is_defi_trigger"::tag =~ /^$is_defi_trigger$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(0)

SELECT cumulative_sum(sum("expected_pnl_post_fill")) FROM "defi_cefi_arbitrage_v0_post_trade" WHERE ("stage" =~ /^$stage$/ AND "mode" =~ /^$mode$/ AND "network" =~ /^$network$/ AND "dex" =~ /^$dex$/ AND "pool" =~ /^$pool$/ AND "contract_error" = '0') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT cumulative_sum(sum("expected_pnl_post_fill")) FROM "defi_cefi_arbitrage_v0_post_trade" WHERE ("stage" =~ /^$stage$/ AND "mode" =~ /^$mode$/ AND "network" =~ /^$network$/ AND "dex" =~ /^$dex$/ AND "pool" =~ /^$pool$/ AND "contract_error" = '0') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT cumulative_sum(sum("selini_paid_bid_usd")) FROM "defi_cefi_arbitrage_v0_auction" WHERE ("stage" =~ /^$stage$/ AND "mode" =~ /^$mode$/ AND "network" =~ /^$network$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(0)

spec.query: SELECT sum("block_duration_us")  / (1000 * count("block_number")) AS "Avg. Block Duration" FROM "defi_cefi_arbitrage_block" WHERE ("stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/ AND "network"::tag =~ /^$network$/) AND $timeFilter

params: DeFi Price Receipt - Block Timestamp ms

spec.query: SELECT max("main_runtime_threads") AS "Runtime Threads", max("runtime_tasks") AS "Runtime Tasks", max("pinned_threads") AS "Pinned Threads" FROM "defi_cefi_arbitrage_process_state" WHERE ("network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/ AND "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "stage"::tag, "mode"::tag fill(null)

SELECT "round", "auction_winner_tag", "winning_bid_usd", "paid_price_usd", "selini_bid_usd", "selini_paid_bid_usd", "selini_computed_bid_usd", "reserve_price_usd", "stage", "mode", "round"  *60000+1741687071000 AS "round_start" FROM "defi_cefi_arbitrage_v0_auction" WHERE ("mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/ AND "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND "network"::tag =~ /^$network$/) AND $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC

SELECT sum("expected_pnl_post_fill") AS "PnL", sum("skew_adjusted_pnl_post_fill") AS "Skew-Adjuted PnL",  sum("expected_pnl_post_fill") - sum("expected_pnl_pre_fill") AS "Slippage",  sum("fill_size_usd") AS "Volume", 10000 * sum("expected_pnl_post_fill") / sum("fill_size_usd") AS "PPM"
FROM "defi_cefi_arbitrage_post_fill_trade"
WHERE ("network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/ AND "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/ AND "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND "is_defi_trigger"::tag =~ /^$is_defi_trigger$/ AND "tx_broadcast_type"::tag =~ /^$tx_broadcast_type$/ AND "trade_type"::tag =~ /^$trade_type$/)
AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY "network"::tag, "stage"::tag, "mode"::tag, "dex"::tag, "pool"::tag
fill(null)

SELECT mean("preemptive_balance_usd") FROM "defi_cefi_arbitrage_asset_balances" WHERE ("network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "token"::tag fill(previous)

SELECT mean("target_balance_usd") FROM "defi_cefi_arbitrage_asset_balances" WHERE ("network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "token"::tag fill(previous)

SELECT
    mean("balance_usd")

SELECT min("gas_balance_usd_pre_fill") FROM "default_defi_retention"."defi_cefi_arbitrage_pre_fill_trade" WHERE ("network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)

SELECT "trader", "tx_hash", "error_type", "socket_addr", "total_broadcast_latency_us" / 1000 AS "total_broadcast_latency_ms"

spec.title: Real-time PnLs by DEX and pool

spec.query:
SELECT
    SUM("pnl_no_hedge") AS "total_pnl_no_hedge",
    SUM("size_usd") AS "total_size_usd"
FROM "default_defi_retention"."defi_cefi_arbitrage_competitor_trade"
WHERE (
  "network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND 
  "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND 
  "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/
) 
AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY
    "dex",
    "pool",
    "taker"

SELECT 
  "time",
  "tx_hash",
  "dex", 
  "pool", 
 "tx_broadcast_type",
  "trade_type",
 "is_cefi_trigger",
 "is_defi_trigger",
 "estimated_network_rt_latency_us" / 1000,
 "total_broadcast_latency_us" / 1000 as "total_broadcast_latency ms",
 "tick_to_trade_latency_us" / 1000 as "tick to trade ms",
 "post_processing_tick_latency_us" / 1000 as "post-processing to trade ms",
 "all_requests_failed",
 "bundle_hash"
FROM defi_cefi_arbitrage_executor
WHERE (
  "network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND 
  "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/ AND 
  "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND 
  "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/ AND 
  "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND
  "is_defi_trigger"::tag =~ /^$is_defi_trigger$/ AND
  "tx_broadcast_type"::tag =~ /^$tx_broadcast_type$/
) 
AND $timeFilter 
ORDER BY time DESC 
LIMIT 30000

SELECT cumulative_sum(sum("pnl_no_hedge_mid_10000ms")) FROM "markout_df" WHERE ("chain"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($interval), "trader"::field fill(0)

SELECT cumulative_sum(sum("pnl_no_hedge_mid_60000ms")) FROM "markout_df" WHERE ("chain"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($interval), "trader"::field fill(0)

SELECT 
  "time",
  "tx_hash_url",
  "taker",
  "failed_fld" AS "failed", 
  "is_cancel",
  "is_cancel_freely",
  "simulation_failed",
  "is_buy", 
  "dex", 
  "pool", 
  "taker",
  "quote_to_swap_duration_ms" / 1000 as "taker_delay_secs", 
  "alive" AS "count", 
  "fill_size_usd", 
  "expected_pnl_pre_fill" AS "exp pre fill pnl", 
  "expected_pnl_pre_swap" AS "exp pre fill swap", 
  "expected_pnl_post_fill" AS "exp post fill pnl", 
  "skew_adjusted_pnl_pre_swap" AS "skew pre fill swap", 
  "expected_pnl_post_fill" - "expected_pnl_pre_fill" AS "pnl slippage", 
  "fh_receive_to_strategy_latency_ns" / 1000000 as "Tao to DeFi ms",
  "pre_fill_unix_ns" / 1000000 AS "pre_fill_unix_ms", 
  "post_fill_unix_ns" / 1000000 AS "post_fill_unix_ms",
 "post_fill_unix_ns" / 1000000 - "pre_fill_unix_ns" / 1000000 AS "delay_ms",
  "unix_minus_block_timestamp_us" / 1000 as "prtcl block millis",
  "estimated_gas", "actual_gas",
  "estimated_bribe_fee_usd", 
  "expected_spread_bps" AS "exp spread bps", 
  "realized_spread_bps" AS "rlzd spread bps", 
  "is_cefi_trigger" AS "cefi trig", 
  "is_defi_trigger" AS "defi trig",
  "sell_skew_bps_pre_fill" - "sell_skew_bps_no_preemptive_pre_fill" as "sell pre-emptive widening bps", "buy_skew_bps_no_preemptive_pre_fill" - "buy_skew_bps_pre_fill" as "buy pre-emptive widening bps",
  "sell_skew_bps_pre_fill" as "sell skew",
  "buy_skew_bps_pre_fill" as "buy skew",
   
  "edge_bps", 
  "tx_index", 
  "block_number_pre_fill" AS "pre fill block", 
  "tx_block", 
  "tx_block" - "block_number_pre_fill" as "fill_delay",
  "defi_fill_price" as "defi fill",



  "priority_fee_per_gas"
FROM "default_defi_retention"."defi_cefi_arbitrage_post_fill_trade"
WHERE (
  "network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND 
  "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/ AND 
  "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND 
  "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/ AND 
  "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND
  "is_rfq_trigger"::tag = 'true'
) 
AND $timeFilter 
ORDER BY time DESC 
LIMIT 30000

SELECT 
  "time",
  "post_fill_unix_ns" / 1000000 AS "post_fill_ms",
  "dex", 
  "pool", 
  "tx_hash_url" as "tx_hash",
  "failed_fld" AS "failed", 
  "is_buy", 
  "alive" AS "count", 
  "order_id",
  "lot_size_usd", 
  "gas_bid_lot_size_usd",
  "fill_size_usd", 
  "expected_pnl_pre_fill" AS "exp pre fill pnl", 
  "expected_pnl_post_fill" AS "exp post fill pnl", 
  "expected_pnl_post_fill" - "expected_pnl_pre_fill" AS "pnl slippage", 
  "excess_pnl" AS "exc pnl",   
  "estimated_bribe_fees_usd", 
  "bribe_fraction" * 100 as "bribe %",
  "original_bribe_fraction" * 100 as "original bribe %",
  "priority_fee_per_gas",
  "tx_broadcast_type",
  "trade_type",
  "num_unique_tx_index",
  "is_replacement",
  "is_cancel",
  "won_timeboost", 
  "tx_timeboosted",
  "soft_timeout",

  "fh_receive_to_strategy_latency_ns" / 1000000 as "Tao to Strategy ms",
  "pre_fill_unix_ns" / 1000000 AS "pre_fill_unix_ms", 
  "post_fill_unix_ns" / 1000000 AS "post_fill_unix_ms",
  "post_fill_unix_ns" / 1000000 - "pre_fill_unix_ns" / 1000000 AS "delay_ms",
  "post_fill_unfinalized_unix_ns" / 1000000 - "pre_fill_unix_ns" / 1000000 AS "unfanilized delay_ms",
  "unix_minus_block_timestamp_us" / 1000 as "unix - block ms",
  
  "bundle_uuid",
  "tx_index", 
  "block_number_pre_fill" AS "pre fill block", 
  "tx_block", 
  "tx_block" - "block_number_pre_fill" as "fill_delay",
  "target_block",
  "landed_on_target_block",
  "block_number_defi_price_pre_fill" as "defi p block",
  "subblock_index_pre_fill" AS "pre fill flashblock", 
  "subblock_index_post_fill" AS "post fill flashblock", 
  "subblock_index_post_fill" - "subblock_index_pre_fill" as "flashblock_delay",
  "subblock_block_number" as "post fill flashblock block",

  "is_cefi_trigger" AS "cefi trig", 
  "is_defi_trigger" AS "defi trig",
  "sell_skew_bps_pre_fill" - "sell_skew_bps_no_preemptive_pre_fill" as "sell pre-emptive widening bps", 
  "buy_skew_bps_no_preemptive_pre_fill" - "buy_skew_bps_pre_fill" as "buy pre-emptive widening bps",
  "sell_skew_bps_pre_fill" as "sell skew",
  "buy_skew_bps_pre_fill" as "buy skew",
  "edge_bps", 
  




  "estimated_gas_used", 
  "gas_used",
  "nonce_address",
  "nonce_value",
  

  "is_buy",
  "defi_fill_price" as "defi fill", 
  "price_slippage_limit", 
  "defi_price_buy_pre_fill" as "defi buy", 
  "defi_price_sell_pre_fill" as "defi sell",
  "buy_threshold" as "buy threshold", 
  "sell_threshold" as "sell threshold",
  ("price_slippage_limit" - "defi_fill_price") * 10000 / "defi_fill_price" as "set slippage vs realized bps", 

  ("defi_price_buy_pre_fill" - "defi_fill_price") * 10000 / "defi_fill_price" as "defi buy slip bps", 
  ("defi_fill_price" - "defi_price_sell_pre_fill") * 10000 / "defi_fill_price" as "defi sell slip bps"


FROM "default_defi_retention"."defi_cefi_arbitrage_pre_fill_trade"
WHERE (
  "network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND 
  "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/ AND 
  "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND 
  "dex"::tag != 'jupiterrfq' AND
  "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/ AND 
  "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND
  "is_defi_trigger"::tag =~ /^$is_defi_trigger$/ AND
  "tx_broadcast_type"::tag =~ /^$tx_broadcast_type$/ AND
  "trade_type"::tag =~ /^$trade_type$/
) 
AND $timeFilter 
ORDER BY time DESC 
LIMIT 30000

SELECT 
  "time",
  "is_buy", 
  "dex", 
  "pool", 
  "alive" AS "count", 
  "lot_size_usd", 
  "fill_size_usd", 
  "expected_pnl_pre_fill" AS "exp pre fill pnl", 
  "expected_pnl_post_fill" AS "exp post fill pnl", 
  "expected_pnl_post_fill" - "expected_pnl_pre_fill" AS "pnl slippage", 
  "excess_pnl" AS "exc pnl", 
  "fh_receive_to_strategy_latency_ns" / 1000000 as "Tao to DeFi ms",
  "pre_fill_unix_ns" / 1000000 AS "pre_fill_unix_ms", 
  "post_fill_unix_ns" / 1000000 AS "post_fill_unix_ms",
 "post_fill_unix_ns" / 1000000 - "pre_fill_unix_ns" / 1000000 AS "delay_ms",
   "post_fill_flashblock_unix_ns" / 1000000 - "pre_fill_unix_ns" / 1000000 AS "optimistic_rcv_delay_ms",
  "time_since_latest_block_pre_fill_us" / 1000 as "ntwrk block millis", 
  "my_timestamp_minus_block_timestamp_us" / 1000 as "prtcl block millis",
  "estimated_gas", "actual_gas",
  "estimated_bribe_fee_usd", 
  "expected_spread_bps" AS "exp spread bps", 
  "realized_spread_bps" AS "rlzd spread bps", 
  "is_cefi_trigger" AS "cefi trig", 
  "is_defi_trigger" AS "defi trig",
  "sell_skew_bps_pre_fill" - "sell_skew_bps_no_preemptive_pre_fill" as "sell pre-emptive widening bps", "buy_skew_bps_no_preemptive_pre_fill" - "buy_skew_bps_pre_fill" as "buy pre-emptive widening bps",
  "sell_skew_bps_pre_fill" as "sell skew",
  "buy_skew_bps_pre_fill" as "buy skew",
   
  "edge_bps", 
  "tx_index", 
  "block_number_pre_fill" AS "pre fill block", 
  "tx_block", 
  "tx_block" - "block_number_pre_fill" as "fill_delay",
  "flashblock_index_pre_fill" AS "pre fill flashblock", 
  "flashblock_index_post_fill" AS "post fill flashblock", 
  "flashblock_index_post_fill" - "flashblock_index_pre_fill" as "flashblock_delay",
  "flashblock_block_number" as "post fill flashblock block",
  "defi_actual_fill_price" as "defi fill", "buy_price_slippage_limit" as "slip. buy", "defi_buy_price_pre_fill" as "defi buy", "buy_threshold" as "buy threshold",  "sell_price_slippage_limit" as "slip. sell", "defi_sell_price_pre_fill" as "defi sell", "sell_threshold" as "sell threshold",

  ("defi_buy_price_pre_fill" - "defi_actual_fill_price") * 10000 / "defi_buy_price_pre_fill" as "defi buy slip bps", 
  ("defi_actual_fill_price" - "defi_sell_price_pre_fill") * 10000 / "defi_sell_price_pre_fill" as "defi sell slip bps", 


  "block_adjustment_bps_pre_fill" as "block adjustment bps"
FROM "default_defi_retention"."defi_cefi_arbitrage_rfq_quote"
WHERE (
  "network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND 
  "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/ AND 
  "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND 
  "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/ AND 
  "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND
  "is_rfq_trigger"::tag = 'true'
) 
AND $timeFilter 
ORDER BY time DESC 
LIMIT 30000

spec.title: Tick to Trade (micros)
spec.description: Includes DeFi Trigger latencies as well which, at the moment, make network calls.

spec.query:
SELECT
  ("defi_price_buy_pre_fill" - "defi_fill_price") * 10000 / "defi_price_buy_pre_fill" as "defi buy slip bps"

FROM "default_defi_retention"."defi_cefi_arbitrage_pre_fill_trade"

WHERE 
 "is_buy"::tag =~ /^true$/ AND
  "network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND 
  "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/ AND 
  "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND
  "dex"::tag != 'jupiterrfq' AND
  "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/ AND
  "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND
  "is_defi_trigger"::tag =~ /^$is_defi_trigger$/ AND
  $timeFilter

SELECT
  ("defi_fill_price" - "defi_price_sell_pre_fill") * 10000 / "defi_price_sell_pre_fill" as "defi sell slip bps"

FROM "default_defi_retention"."defi_cefi_arbitrage_pre_fill_trade"

WHERE 
 "is_buy"::tag =~ /^false$/ AND
  "network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND 
  "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/ AND 
  "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND 
  "dex"::tag != 'jupiterrfq' AND
  "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/ AND 
  "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND
  $timeFilter

SELECT

("defi_fill_price" - "price_slippage_limit") / "defi_fill_price" * 1000

FROM "default_defi_retention"."defi_cefi_arbitrage_pre_fill_trade"

WHERE 
 "is_buy"::tag =~ /^false$/ AND
  "network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND 
  "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/ AND 
  "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND 
  "dex"::tag != 'jupiterrfq' AND
  "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/ AND 
  "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND
  $timeFilter

SELECT

("price_slippage_limit" - "defi_fill_price") / "defi_fill_price" * 1000

FROM "default_defi_retention"."defi_cefi_arbitrage_pre_fill_trade"

WHERE 
 "is_buy"::tag =~ /^true$/ AND
  "network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND 
  "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/ AND 
  "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND 
  "dex"::tag != 'jupiterrfq' AND
  "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/ AND 
  "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND
  $timeFilter

SELECT cumulative_sum(sum("expected_pnl_post_fill")) FROM "defi_cefi_arbitrage_v0_post_trade" WHERE ("stage" =~ /^$stage$/ AND "mode" =~ /^$mode$/ AND "network" =~ /^$network$/ AND "dex" =~ /^$dex$/ AND "pool" =~ /^$pool$/ AND "contract_error" = '0') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT median("estimated_network_rt_latency_us")  / 1000 AS "Estimated Total RT" FROM "default_defi_retention"."defi_cefi_arbitrage_executor" WHERE ("stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/ AND "network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT 100 * mean("sx_broadcast_size") / mean("broadcast_subset_size") 
FROM "default_defi_retention"."defi_cefi_arbitrage_executor"
